adjudicated.en: Maybe I had read in a book that the history of witch hunts was extremely vicious, and it's possible I have ended up having embraced the prejudice that witches are indeed truly wicked, or something of the sort.
comments: An innocent sentence that is yet a likely troll. First, I can't help thinking that using a word with the 烈 kanji (which includes the radical for 'fire') is either a really bad choice for talking about witch hunts, or intended to make this sentence sound a lot more comical than it seems. The troll comes to the forefront when considering that Taichi seems to have bought into the anti-witch propaganda.

Who actually ever reads about the fierceness of the witch hunts and thinks maybe they were correct? Especially considering most of that fierceness is entirely the invention of 17th century anti-Catholic and anti-Christian propaganda! This is a strangely odd conclusion consistent with CCA0015C, and laterally with the Phantasy Star II reference. I'm considering this as another tongue-in-cheek side-reference to Christianity that looks chastising only to the untrained eye, like making the local prophet a zombie or having characters scream "goddamn" and "Jesus" in English. -GHS
